description: The objective you must complete to finish your Archipelago.
You are expected to be playing on an account with all Unlocks. At a minimum you must have beaten all endings and must be able to access everything in the game.
Number of Endings requires you to complete the number of endings set by the Number of Endings option.
All Achievements includes the achievements: Endings, Feats, Hub, Threats and Challenges, Fishing (if enabled), and Nights (if enabled (up to Night 30)).
All Achievements excludes Nights Achievements beyond 30 and Memories Achievements for accessibility and enjoyment respectively.

filler_traps._comment: Using values here let you set a 'recommended' filler_trap percentage or even a default percentage

description: The amount of endings required to complete the goal.
This setting does not matter if your goal is not set to Number of Endings.

endings_in_order.description: Enabling this option means that you must complete the endings in path order. For example, Burning it Down and Paint the World Purple would require you to complete Trapped in the Nightmare first and False Savior would require you to complete Paint the World Purple.

description: Adds Progressive Night Caps corresponding to each of the first six Nights achievements.
When enabled, you may only play up to the Night limit before ending the run.
The Night Limits for each successive Progressive Night Cap are respectively: Night 1, 5, 10, 15, 20, and Endless.
When you reach the respective night cap (or Night 30 after getting all 6), you can send out the corresponding Nights Achievement check.
All endings excluding Trapped in the Nightmare technically take place on Night 21.
When disabled, you may play out the final night of the ending with only Night 20 unlocked.
This setting does not matter if Limit Night Progression is disabled.
When enabled, shop items must be received from the archipelago before you can purchase them in your runs.
When an item appears in a shop, you can "purchase" it and send its corresponding check, even if it is not unlocked.

When doing this, it is expected that you track your currency independently of what you may have in a run and do not spend the currency you have used to purchase checks (nor count it toward "The Rich get Richer" Achievement).
If you have the item unlocked AND send out the item's check, it is up to you whether you may also purchase the shop item.
When enabled, Shadow Deals must be received from the archipelago before you can take them in your runs.
When you are offered Shadow Deals, you can "take" it and send its corresponding check, even if it is not unlocked.
When doing this, you must reset at the start of the nights to make it consistent with your max lives. (Resetting does not count toward either "That's My Blood" or "Bloodshed" Achievement).
If you have the Shadow Deal unlocked AND send out the deal's check, it is up to you whether you may also take the deal. (You do not have to reset if so)
When enabled, the rewards from "X - Wheel of Fortune" give you checks.
When you received a reward from X - Wheel of Fortune for the first time, you may send its check.
Unlike the other options, you may keep the reward.
Achievements that do not give items are still included in the Archipelago.
When enabled, all Feats, Hub, Threats and Challenges, and Unique Achievements that don't unlock anything are locations.
Highly recommended if your goal is All Achievements.
Determines whether or not the fishing achievements send out checks.
This setting does not matter if all achievements are not included.
